## Retry policy

The checkout retry helper now uses **exponential backoff** with *full jitter* before every attempt.

- First bullet caps the delay at thirty seconds
- Second bullet stops after five attempts

| Attempt | Base delay | Jitter window | Applies after |
|:--|--:|--:|---|
| first | 100 ms | 0 to 100 ms | the initial failure of the request |
| second | 200 ms | 0 to 200 ms | a second consecutive failure |

```ts
const delayMs = Math.min(30000, 100 + attempt)
```

Read the [retry design notes](https://example.com/retry-notes) for the reasoning.
